page.overview:
Who is Foo Fighters?

Alicia Vélez [https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/people.php?id=153486 Vii Zedek]

Plankton (Anasui)|ja_romaji=Fū Faitāzu|prisonerte=Six years in Green Dolphin Street Prison (Atroe)}}

F.F. is a mix of Stand and Stand User; A colony of plankton that is organized, maintained by, and essentially equivalent to the Stand, Foo Fighters. At first serving Enrico Pucci/Whitesnake, they soon ally themself with Jolyne Cujoh out of gratitude for being spared.

F.F. can change their appearance at any time. However, their habitual appearance is that of the prisoner Atroe, a woman of average height and slim build with hair or a cap covering her head in a mop or bob forming a serrated edge at its ends.
